blocks.title: A national digital-government agency — how the pattern runs
blocks.note: Under the hood this pattern runs on one rule: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy across Public Sector & Government, so a regression is a cohort, never an estate.

items: Permits and benefit files paper-shaped; backlogs measured in months.
AI proposals blocked by accountability gaps; no oversight framework.
Agency data islands prevented tell-us-once services.

blocks.x: Casework agents assemble evidence with officer-approval gates; every AI-assisted decision carries transparency notices, human oversight and Compass-generated conformity documentation mapped to the EU AI Act; the interagency exchange (consent-aware, event-driven) enabled tell-us-once across four agencies.

What the delivery actually looks like week to week: weeks 1–2 produce the signed baseline: current per case file performance, method note, and a control owner who co-signs every later claim. the middle block runs the pilot against live permitting & licensing data at deliberately small scope: one path, one team, one region, expanded only after its eval gate holds. What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy in A national digital-government agency, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.. At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: cost and quality telemetry land in the same view your owners read across Public Sector & Government, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.

items: Nothing in this topology is accidental: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default for Public Sector & Government at scale, so the question of how we know gets a pointer, not a paragraph.
